question: How do we make sure we both feel cared for?

parties.label: Alice
parties.text: Bob doesn't give me enough emotional attention. When he's on his phone at dinner it feels like I'm not a priority. I need us to have time together that's just for us.

parties.label: Bob
parties.text: I show commitment through what I do: I cook, I handle the bills, I fixed the car last week. I'm tired after work so I relax on my phone because it's the only downtime I get.
